SWS DIAGNOSIS
TSB Revision
SIMPLIFIED WIRING SYSTEM (SWS)
54B-155
CIRCUIT OPERATION
When the fog light switch is turned on while the front-
ECU is illuminating the taillights or headlights (low-
beam), the ETACS-ECU sends a `light on' signal to 
the front-ECU, causing the front-ECU to illuminate 
the fog lights. 
TECHNICAL DESCRIPTION (COMMENT)
If the taillights and headlights illuminate normally, the 
fog light relay, the fog light switch, the front-ECU or 
the ETACS-ECU may be defective.
NOTE: If only one of the fog lights or the fog light 
indicator light does not illuminate, the relevant bulb 
may be burned out or the harness wire between the 
defective light and the fog light relay may be 
defective. In this case, check the relevant circuit by 
referring to GROUP 90, Fog Light P.90-116.
TROUBLESHOOTING HINTS
• Malfunction of the fog light relay
• Malfunction of the fog light switch 
• Malfunction of the front-ECU 
• Malfunction of the ETACS-ECU 
• Damaged harness wires or connectors
